title: Christina
platform: High-Resolution Print Media & Visual Franchise Assets
requirements: End-to-end translation of a five-character hand-drawn children's illustration lineup into high-fidelity, animation-ready 3D intellectual properties. Characters included a whimsical dragon with unique hind-leg emblem overlays, an armored cow with accessory toggle meshes, a turtle with a ramen bowl shell containing fluid rigs for noodle hair, dual mirrored guardian dogs, and a detailed possum.
achievements: Transformed artistic sketches into production-grade 4K illustration assets and source rigs
Engineered modular material and bone switches allowing interactive armor and prop toggles
Formulated advanced chain armature physics to animate character hair realistically
